name: Transit Swap callBytes claimTokens approval drain
summary: Transit's bridge helper 0x0b47275e, an authorized caller of the TransitSwap claimTokens proxy, decoded the claimTokens token, sender, recipient and amount from user-supplied callBytes data. Through the router, attackers made it pull any user's approved USDT, BUSD, USDC and WBNB to themselves; copycats repeated the call within hours.

campaign.selection: txs not sent by 0x5f0b31aa in which 0xed1afc8c.claimTokens (reached via router 0x8785bb8d -> 0x0b47275e.callBytes) moves a nonzero amount from an address other than tx.from; candidates are txs with Approval(owner, 0xed1afc8c) where owner != tx.from in blocks 21816000-21950000, plus WBNB transfers from 0xed1afc8c approvers, each confirmed by trace

notes: The age runs from setBridgeProxy on the claimTokens proxy, which granted the helper its claim right (rule 8) after the router's addBridge(1) routed to it; the later setFeeModel only changed a fee lookup.

Loss is the 748 drained approvers' net outflow over the attacker's 12 txs and 128 copycat txs from five senders (0x00000000050c, 0x87be7fa8, 0x0000000038b8, 0xa957910c, 0xcc3d51c1); the attacker's later ~70% return is a recovery and is not netted.
